messages:
Ana Soto: Hey folks, SI partner (AuroraTech) pushed a new co-branded one-pager and a marketplace tile. Couple of quick alignment asks before we approve for listing: 1) CTA wording differs (Aurora: "Try Aurora + Redwood" vs our preferred "Try Redwood on Aurora") 2) Logo order on hero (they put Aurora left, Redwood right) 3) Badge placement overlaps legal blurb at smaller breakpoints. Links: https://drive.example/aurora/redwood-onepager_v3.pdf, https://figma.com/file/efgh5678/aurora-redwood-marketplace
Ravi Patel: Skimming the one-pager now. CTA swap is fine from product POV, but we should be consistent with marketplace copy. We use "Run Redwood on AuroraTech" in other listings.
Claire O'Neil: Legal: CTA must not imply exclusivity. "Run Redwood on AuroraTech" is ok. We also need trademark attributions under the logos and a short IP line: "AuroraTech and Redwood Inference are registered trademarks of their respective owners."
Marco Ruiz: Design note: If we flip the logo order to Redwood left / Aurora right it might conflict with their brand guidelines (Aurora prefers left alignment). Do we have permission to change order?
Ana Soto: Good point. @Claire can we request an exception for marketplace? Or alternatively allow both layouts depending on channel.
Claire O'Neil: We can request an exception for the marketplace tile only. Ask Aurora to sign off via a quick email thread or add a line in their brand permission doc.
DevBot: Reminder: marketplace thumbnail max size 640x640, recommended SVG for clarity.
Ravi Patel: Also noticed the hero has a small caption that reads "Beta integration". Is that still accurate? We moved out of beta last quarter.
Marco Ruiz: That caption should be removed. I'll prepare an updated hero with caption removed and badge moved below the headline.
Ana Soto: Can you also provide a 1x and 2x PNG export for the tile? Some marketplaces require raster fallback.
Marco Ruiz: Yep — exporting 600x600 and 1200x1200 PNGs from SVG.
Claire O'Neil: On the trademark line, also include the registered symbol where applicable. Aurora gave us a list of their marks in the brand doc.
Ravi Patel: For the CTA language, propose a short style guide snippet: 
- marketplace CTA: "Run Redwood on AuroraTech"
- one-pager CTA: "Deploy Redwood with AuroraTech"
Keep the verbs consistent but allow slight variation across assets.
Ana Soto: Sounds good. I'll message Aurora asking for logo-order permission and to confirm they approve the CTA swaps. Claire once they send permission can you do the legal sign-off?
Claire O'Neil: Yes — will sign off after their confirmation and once the trademark line is present.
Marco Ruiz: Uploaded updated hero + PNGs to the figma file: figma.com/file/efgh5678/aurora-redwood-marketplace (assets tab). Also added two badge placements to review.
Ravi Patel: Quick accessibility note: the hero contrast ratio drops when we move the badge over the image. Add a subtle dark overlay at ~12% to maintain text contrast.
Marco Ruiz: Added overlay option B and named frames: "hero-overlay-A" and "hero-overlay-B".
Ana Soto: Timeline: need final assets and legal by Friday EOD so marketplace publish can go next week. Any blockers?
Claire O'Neil: Waiting on Aurora logo-order permission and their trademark list. Otherwise ready to sign once those arrive.
Ravi Patel: No other product blockers.
Ana Soto: Great — tagging Aurora marketing to expedite. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
DevBot: Note: Please attach final signed permissions to the asset bundle for compliance audits.
